title: A private glass, a public death
text: Grant Larceny died after drinking his private toast at 6:49. A botanical cardiac toxin is present in his silver coupe. The communal food and cordial decanter test clean. The reference sample missing from conservation contains the same compound. The empty coupe was delivered at 6:40; cordial was first poured at 6:46. One guest acted alone. These findings identify the contaminated vessel, not the guest who contaminated it.

title: An evening of unfinished business
text: Grant’s papers concern the naming agreement, disputed objects, unpaid invoices, a family trust and threats to careers. The warning note, altered labels and camera shutdown are also being examined. A person can conceal wrongdoing unrelated to the death. Read the discoveries alongside what the guests say, rather than treating a scandal as a verdict.

title: Private service / movement statement
text: Service delivered Grant’s empty coupe to the salon at 6:40 and poured the cordial at 6:46. The glass was not removed between delivery and the toast. The salon camera had been disconnected at Grant’s request. Several guests entered the salon during preparations. The East Gallery, balcony and Star Bowl display alcove are different positions within the exhibition. The printed programme is retained with the press papers; revised production records are still being checked.

title: Security run / installation record
text: Controller S-2 logged a mounting alert at 6:37, the alcove curtain locked at 6:38, and the first reopening at 7:00. The surrounding East Gallery and balcony remained accessible. The advance 6:48 cue was cancelled. The installation photograph was logged at 6:31 on 30 October. It is an installation record, whereas the enclosed-cabinet rendering is a proposal from 20 October. The controller and installation files are independent records.

title: Two clocks / one poisoned rim
text: Concentrated toxin follows wipe tracks inside Grant’s coupe. The sample could be carried on museum linen. Key and linen access was shared; that audit alone cannot identify a poisoner. The reported phones, watches, camera and service clock were checked against security time. Only the brass East Gallery clock differed: it ran ten minutes fast. Its mechanism was not corrected before the gala.
